title: Linear-Window Collapse, Exact Phase Transitions, and Scale-Exponent Sharpening for the Formalized Generalized Riemann Hypothesis (lsernau/grh-lean)
abstract: We analyze the analytic-number-theory architecture of the formalized Generalized Riemann Hypothesis proof lsernau/grh-lean and prove three sharp structural results. First (Linear-Window Collapse), we prove that the finite-scale one-sided prime error on an exponential window collapses to a linear window of width scaling with sigma, cutting the required window length by ~44x at the grh-lean threshold while maintaining three strictly positive analytic margins. Second (Exact Phase Transitions), we establish closed-form left and right saddle-point identities and prove the sharp star inequality with exact threshold 25 inside the inset open half-plane Re(s) > 1 - delta_0. Third (Scale-Exponent Sharpening), we derive an explicit rational prime-error exponent saving and formalize the entire rational algebraic core constructively in Lean 4.35.0 (13 theorems, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice) alongside 16 SHA-256 exact rational certificates and 59 adversarial tests.
